text: Let's actually ingest a continuous flow of events — Eventstreams.
An event hub source, filtered in flight, can land in both an eventhouse for real-time queries and a lakehouse for later batch analysis — the same stream, more than one destination.
New eventstream, add a source, add a destination, publish — and it starts running immediately, continuously, the same always-on idea as a processing-time trigger.

This is conceptually the same job as Autoloader — picking up new data automatically, no manual intervention — just for a genuinely different shape: a continuous stream of events, not files landing periodically.
Source, transformation, destination — and destinations can genuinely be plural. Next lesson: event sources, Azure Event Hubs and IoT Hub, for real.
